payload.reason: The evidence provides insights into the rationale for using set expansion approaches in constructing dictionaries from customer reviews, particularly focusing on the unique characteristics of user-generated text.

claims.text: Entity set expansion (ESE) enhances a seed set of entities by discovering new entities from user-generated text, which is abundant and largely unlabeled.
User-generated text contains unique characteristics, such as non-named and vague entities, which necessitate the use of ESE methods to accurately capture relevant entities.
Existing ESE methods often do not generalize well to user-generated text, highlighting the need for tailored approaches in this domain.
